div.div:
NOTE : At step 4 , only Output of previous iteration will be FED into next iteration in place of "temp_name" in
"FROM CLAUSE" , even though "FROM clause" contains entire "temp_name" ,
that doesn't mean entire accumulated output set will be fed to next iteration .
This is very crucial understanding in terms of its recursive nature
